evidence: The 2022 cyclic-cover moduli paper proves global existence and boundary results for p-rank strata, but does not give the coefficient-normalized H_{a,b} intersection.
Frei proves nonexistence of smooth genus-four hyperelliptic curves with a-number three in characteristic five; this does not prescribe p-rank or distinguish a-numbers one and two in this family.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Generic moduli existence/dimension and the stronger a-number>=3 obstruction do not imply coefficient-specific formulas for stable rank, nor a unique transverse rank-zero point. We do not claim such broad known conclusions as contributions.

Earlier a-number-three nonexistence is already known and explicitly excluded from novelty.

value.rationale: Complete stable-rank stratification of a natural cyclic order-six genus-four family at the excluded small characteristic, with geometric elliptic quotient, two-dimensional complementary stable Cartier factor and a unique transverse p-rank-zero smooth coefficient pair. This resolves a motivated precise arithmetic locus beyond the known rank<=3 bound; it is not an arbitrary finite table.
